message: When the skies darkened and the wind started howling, my grandkids and I found ourselves hunkered down at home, wondering how to pass the time. Instead of the usual screens, we dusted off some old board games and had a surprisingly fierce tournament of Scrabble. Who knew that a little storm could bring us back to low-tech fun? Sometimes, it's the simple things that help us weather life's little tempests. What’s your go-to game when the power goes out? 🎲
